task.description: Implement the validated design at src/design/iss0618-scheduler-lock-and-error-signaling.md to fix GH #567 / ISS-0618 in src/scheduler/scheduler.zig. This is a git-setup-already-done run (branch feature/WF03-GH567-20260808 exists and is checked out) -- do NOT run git-setup again, only implement + commit. Fix 1 (TC-SCH-02-02): when the ordinary-timer FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED query (lines ~189-215) returns 0 rows, issue a second lock-agnostic existence query (same WHERE/ORDER BY as the original, no FOR UPDATE) before deciding the outcome -- zero rows there means genuinely PollOutcome.none, one or more rows means PollOutcome.skipped_locked. Fix 2 (TC-SCH-02-03): only the appendTimerFiredEventInTx call site inside fire_blk (line ~338) changes -- on failure, still roll back the transaction and still call handleTimerFireError (preserving ISS-303's retry bookkeeping unchanged), then return SchedulerError.TransactionFailed directly instead of falling through to false/.none. Every other fire_blk step (now_rows query, recurrence parsing, rearm, markTimerFiredInTx, etc.) keeps its existing catch-and-swallow-into-false behavior, unchanged. Read the full design doc before starting -- it has precise structure and cites the exact validated line numbers.
acceptance_criteria: TC-SCH-02-02 passes: skipped_locked > 0 when a due timer is locked by another process
TC-SCH-02-03 passes: SchedulerError.TransactionFailed is returned on the forced duplicate-idempotency-key failure, and the timer stays PENDING (pending_count == 1)
TC-SCH-303-03 and TC-SCH-303-04 (tests/integration/sch303_timer_dlq_test.zig) continue to pass unchanged -- run them explicitly to confirm no regression
